The '''Vorzyd sector''' was one of nine [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that comprised the [[Commonality]], a political confederation in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Vorzyd sector contained the [[Vorzyd Cluster]].

During the time of the Galactic Empire, the Vorzyd sector was under Imperial control, and presumably included [[Deepdock fleet]]s for repairing various ships in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. However, it was later attacked by the Rebel Alliance some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], via a strategy formed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], who was inspired by information included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
